items.title: Use prompt caching with open-weight models on Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Many generative AI applications resend the same long context on every request. Prompt caching lets open-weight models on Amazon Bedrock reuse it to reduce input cost and latency. items.title: Best practices for writing Denied Topics in Amazon Bedrock Guardrails
items.summary: With Denied Topics in Amazon Bedrock Guardrails, you block a content category by describing it in plain language, and the guardrail matches by meaning rather than keyword, which can block more than you intend. This post presents eight best practices for writing a topic precisely enough that the guardrail blocks what you mean and passes what you don't.
